systems.country_label: SIPT; CREDOP, called the heart of the project
systems.owner: Ministere de la Securite publique et de l'Immigration; launched in 2016 with European Union support and implemented by INTERPOL
systems.tiers: Not yet operational at the third steering committee (2025, year only): CREDOP is to give instant information on criminal antecedents and help identify wanted persons, weapons, vehicles and other objects, and SIPT is also to collect crime statistics; Chad is described as the only Sahel-belt country not yet in the SIPAO programme; no station-level entry stated

note: The document describes SIPT as an antecedents, wanted-persons and stolen-objects file that will also yield crime statistics, a few months from the project's end and not yet operational; it does not say stations enter reports or cases in it, so there is no fact for station records.
